title: Engineering leads huddle summary — 2026-07-29
agenda: Dedicated capacity rollout timeline and soft SLOs
Model pinning guidance for Private customers
notes:
(fast, meeting-style notes — messy, for follow-ups)

1) Incident/paging status
- Brief: two P3 regressions this week related to prefix cache eviction under sudden QPS spikes. Both mitigated by emergency throttle rule. No customer-facing errors but spike in latency for 95th.
- Action: Ravi to push retention tweak + alert threshold change (INF-2345) by 2026-08-02. Diego to validate private-deployments config doesn't mirror same aggressive eviction by 2026-08-04.
- Question left: should we add a KV-cache health metric to the console? Lin to prototype metric panel and alert proposal next week.

2) Dedicated capacity rollout
- Arjun: pilot customers onboarded; throughput targets meeting expectations, but headroom for multi-tenant preemption is smaller than modeled. Need tweak to autoscale headroom policy.
- Decision: delay broad Dedicated upsell by two weeks to tighten autoscale policy and run soak test. New tentative launch window: 2026-08-18.
- Action: Arjun + Maya to produce a short runbook for preemption behavior and clear customer-facing docs by 2026-08-11. Linked PR: runtime/pull/452.

3) Fallback routing experiments
- Experiment: route warm requests to quantized variant when high latency predicted. Early internal A/B shows 8–12% cost savings with net 30ms median latency increase for non-critical routes.
- Concern: some handlers show hallucination risk increase in edge prompts when using q4-based variant. Hannah flagged potential UX regressions.
- Triage plan: product-led evaluation set to be run on 7 representative prompt families. Maya to coordinate eval run; results expected 2026-08-03.

4) Model pinning for Private customers
- Diego: customers ask for stronger guarantees on pinned model artifacts (checksum + provenance). Current docs are light.
- Agreement: require cryptographic checksum and provenance metadata for any pinned model bundle. Diego to draft spec + integration checklist by 2026-08-06.

5) Observability and SLOs
- Lin: working on token-level cost attribution per route; prototype dashboard next week. Need buy-in on retention (14 vs 90 days).
- Decision lean: default 30-day retention for team dashboards; longer retention as paid opt-in. Lin to capture policy in confluence page.

6) Open blockers & resource asks
- Serving-runtime asks for 2 FTE (backend infra) to land the autoscale changes and fallback rollout. Requesting hiring prioritization.
- Action: Arjun to bring hiring ask to Eng PM sync; Maya to draft justification slide for exec review by 2026-08-05.

7) AOB
- Cross-team demo day scheduled 2026-08-12 (demo owners: Maya, Hannah, Lin). Prep checklist to be circulated.
- Quick wins: enable per-customer KV-cache toggle in next canary to help Private negotiations (Diego owns).
